# antikythera-spectral _research/

**Auto-generated. Do not edit.**

These files are exact copies of selected modules from
`docs/antikythera-maths/research/` (the SSOT). They ship in
the wheel so that consumers who `pip install antikythera-spectral`
without the monorepo can still drive the encoder.

To refresh: run `python codegen/regenerate.py`.
Drift between this directory and the SSOT is caught by
`test_data_freshness.py`.
